title: h0ffmann: the profile of Matheus Hoffmann, the aquatic Prometheus
description:
All rights reserved. It is the personal profile of Matheus Hoffmann: the page that GitHub shows under his name, his CV and his site, at https://h0ffmann.github.io/h0ffmann/. It may be read and cited; it may not be copied, adapted or used as a template for another person's profile (REUSE.md).

The profile tells one arc, from a kid athlete to open research, and indexes his open work on wave modelling, game theory and self-improving apps. That work is not in this record. Each work is in its own repository, under its own licence, with its own DOI: marola (10.5281/zenodo.23224155), WW3 GPU Lab (10.5281/zenodo.23221351), picasso (10.5281/zenodo.23311208) and Closed Source: The God that Failed (10.5281/zenodo.23333656). Whoever writes about him or his work cites all of them.
